firstPlayerRule: Flip the Hi-Lo chip. If it lands on “Hi”, the oldest player starts; on “Lo”, the youngest player starts.
internalEvidence: Fetched the Gamewright-hosted rules PDF listed on gamewright.com/rules and extracted its text with pdftotext. PDF page 1: "4. Flip the Hi-Lo chip and place it next to the draw pile. If the chip landed on ‘Hi’ the oldest player starts, if it landed on ‘Lo’ the youngest player starts."
